high_level_description: stc brand style, three Saudi colleagues in a purple-lit meeting room watching a woman present video content on a wall-mounted screen.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A purple-lit meeting room with a framed abstract poster, potted plants, and a wooden conference table with laptops and tea glasses.

elements.desc: Two men wearing white thobes and red-and-white checkered ghutras, seated at the table watching the screen.
A woman wearing a grey abaya and hijab, standing and pointing at a video streaming interface on the wall-mounted screen.
A man wearing a white thobe and red-and-white checkered ghutra, seated with his back to the camera, pointing toward the screen.
